subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Should native chats refresh an expired operator widget capability when no node route is live, or should operator fallback be removed so widget rendering requires a refreshable node route?
rationale: The choice affects both user-visible recovery and the Gateway capability/TLS authorization boundary, so implementation mechanics alone cannot establish the intended trust model.

options.title: Add operator refresh
options.body: Define a narrow operator-authorized surface refresh path, preserve TLS identity binding, and cover expired history reloads on Android and Apple.

options.title: Require node route
options.body: Remove operator fallback and render an unavailable state whenever a refreshable node route is absent.

options.title: Accept reconnect recovery
options.body: Retain the current fallback and explicitly accept reconnect as the recovery for expired operator capabilities.

recommendation.title: Add operator refresh
recommendation.body: Define a narrow operator-authorized surface refresh path, preserve TLS identity binding, and cover expired history reloads on Android and Apple.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows the broadest involvement in this feature's rendering, Gateway refresh, and TLS-hardening surfaces.
